fieldguide.dracolotl.dracolotl_summoning: Place the obsidian as shown, then the ender crystals. Then, place the egg on the pillar, and right click it.
fieldguide.entity.dracolotl.dracolotl.de:
Successor of the late Ender Dragon, the Dracolotl is the cutest apex predator. They can fly, breathe underwater, play dead to gain an upper fin in combat, and even exhale Dragon's Breath. 

They love munching on Chorus Flowers!
